chunks: From him, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Thālith عليه السلام, who said:
I wrote to him asking about the water buffalo: for how many does it suffice in the udhiyah? The reply came: if it is a male, then for one; and if it is a female, then for seven.

key_terms.الْجَامُوسِ: water buffalo, the animal being asked about for sacrifice
key_terms.سَبْعَةٍ: seven persons on whose behalf it suffices
key_terms.يُجْزِي: suffices or is valid on behalf of

ai.seo_question: For how many people does a male or female water buffalo suffice in the udhiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the sufficiency of a water buffalo in the udhiyah. It states that a male water buffalo suffices for one person, while a female suffices for seven, indicating a juristic distinction in sacrificial eligibility.
